status: Task design only; no runtime implementation or physics simulation
provenance: All navigation, grasp, pipette, container, fixture-QC and cleanup mechanics are authored task connectors; scientific conditions in branch stages are independently source-bound

mobile_actor.type: authored wheeled-base plus gripper/pipette tool interface
mobile_actor.scope: topological navigation and discrete object interaction; no travel physics
carry_rules: one tray or vessel at a time
glass in a supported holder/tray, not free-floating

exchange: place specimen vessel in supported work area
open specimen vessel and correct reagent bottle
aspirate spent task liquid into pipette
dispense spent liquid into designated waste token
aspirate required reagent aliquot from its bottle
mix: read required recipe card and component labels
place labeled empty mixing vial in rack
open correct component and mixing vial
transfer one declared component task aliquot
repeat for every required component; retain parent lot IDs
label resultant mix with recipe ID
incubate: verify specimen vessel closed or source sealing state recorded
set source temperature and duration or explicit authored gap-card timer
wash: perform exchange with indicated wash buffer
if dwell stated, seat vessel and wait stated task time
repeat the source number of cycles; record each separate cycle
mount: navigate to preparation bench with specimen
read source medium or authored-medium gap card
place compatible holder/support on clean work area
grasp glass by edge using authored forceps
transfer same specimen-bearing carrier to holder
apply source medium task aliquot or select premixed mounting token
seat cover/support and verify orientation marker
secure holder and close transport tray
acquire: navigate to correct optical station with closed tray
stop acquisition and close illumination shutter
retract objective to task loading position
seat compatible holder in stage insert and engage clamp
apply immersion-oil token only for oil objective variant
close protective cover where the authored station has one
select detector path and source modality
set source optical/acquisition parameters; record gap-card presets separately
use stage controls to find field cue
adjust fine focus from preview cues
set exposure/illumination using authored unsaturated preview choice when unreported
record field identity and stack bounds
save raw dataset under specimen/carrier/field/modality lineage
unload: retract objective to task loading position
grasp holder and return to tray
store specimen in its labeled slot
clean objective/oil-contact proxy with designated cleaning token
dispose of used tips and task waste
leave stage empty, shutter closed, station idle

complete card timer if supplied; do not replace missing source value with fabricated number

atomic_action_contract.navigate: changes actor zone only; carried closed object travels with actor
atomic_action_contract.grasp: requires accessible free object and empty tool; changes support to held
atomic_action_contract.place: requires held object and compatible empty support; updates support relation
atomic_action_contract.open_close: requires target present and accessible; changes cap/lid/clamp state
atomic_action_contract.attach_tip: requires pipette and fresh tip; tip becomes used upon source contact
atomic_action_contract.aspirate_dispense: requires open source/destination, correct task recipe aliquot, compatible tip and same station; transfers material lineage, never arbitrary scientific volume
atomic_action_contract.set_control: changes one exposed control while prerequisite interlocks allow it
atomic_action_contract.wait_timer: advances virtual elapsed task time; no biological model
atomic_action_contract.inspect: returns one authored cue corresponding to world state; does not mutate specimen
atomic_action_contract.acquire: engine emits immutable dataset record only if mounting, focus, settings and lineage prerequisites hold
atomic_action_contract.save: links immutable acquisition/derivative ID into manifest; cannot fabricate acquisition
atomic_action_contract.clean: requires cleaning token and access; consumes token and resets task contact state

bad_action_rules: Wrong reagent changes recipe lineage and invalidates that preparation stage; no undo button restores consumed specimen
Wrong specimen cannot be repaired by renaming; remount correct specimen or restart new specimen lineage
Opening a moving tray or changing objective while clamped at acquisition pose is rejected
A timer on the wrong station does not complete incubation
A rendered frame or user-authored success flag never creates an acquisition event
